title: Stairwells?
content: Just discovered another reoccurring location in nearly all my Mall World dreams- stairwells. I usually can’t relate to peoples posts about anything “industrial” looking, but the stairwells always are. I’m often alone while traveling from floor to floor in these areas but there are a few times I run into others. Do you guys go here? Extra note- Like two weeks ago i ran into two guys in a stairwell and then we all started cloning ourselves and then went on an amusement park ride. I brought up mallworld to them and offered to explore, so it was all very lucid. If by any chance these people are in this sub, that would be so insane!!!
